chapter.title: Support routines
chapter.para: The kernel carries the routines of the C library that it needs, since it cannot use the library of a partition.

section.title: SRQ_JET_LIB_001
section.para: JetOS shall provide the kernel with the routines of the C library that copy, fill, move, compare and search memory and that measure, compare and search strings, with the behaviour that the C standard gives them (strings compared without regard to case where the name says so).

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The kernel code uses them in the usual way, and the behaviour must be the standard one.

section.title: SRQ_JET_LIB_002
section.para: JetOS shall provide formatted output that writes to the main console and into a buffer of a given size, which it terminates with a NUL and cuts to size, with the integer, hexadecimal, pointer, character, string and percent conversions of the C standard.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Messages are formatted in the kernel.
